Of the two common neighbors of the candidate link A–D (dashed), only B (accent) is in the pair's community, so only B counts, with 1 over its degree 2. C is ignored. The card gives the score 0.5." width="100%"} The resource allocation index sums `1 / degree` over the common neighbors of two nodes, so rarely connected shared neighbors count more (see `resource_allocation_index()`). Soundarajan and Hopcroft's community variant only counts common neighbors in the same community as the pair, and gives `0` to pairs in different communities. Communities come from a node attribute. The graph is treated as undirected and simple. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ebunch]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[tuple[Union[int, str], Union[int, str]]] | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Optional list of `(u, v)` pairs to score. If `None` (default), every pair of non-adjacent nodes is scored. [community]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [["community"]{.st}]{.doc-parameter-default} : Name of the node attribute holding community labels (default `"community"`). ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [list[tuple[int, int, float]]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : `(u, v, score)` triples with node IDs. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If the graph is directed, a node lacks the community attribute or does not exist. ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} Each pair costs one neighbor-set intersection. The scores match NetworkX's `ra_index_soundarajan_hopcroft`. ## Examples {.doc-examples} A and D share B (degree 2, same community) and C (another community), so only B counts: ::: {#258bff83 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec g = ec.Graph().add_nodes( [("A", {"community": 0}), ("B", {"community": 0}), ("C", {"community": 1}), ("D", {"community": 0})] ) g.add_edges([("A", "B"), ("A", "C"), ("B", "D"), ("C", "D")]) g.ra_index_soundarajan_hopcroft([("A", "D")])[0][2] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 0.5 ``` ::: :::
